forward_by_eps.note: Walk-forward cohorts (top decile by skill over prior snapshots only), 10-session excess vs the average stock, EPS story as known at the snapshot (60-day filing-lag buffer). Era Aug–Oct 2026 only, overlapping windows, single regime — descriptive, not a forecast.

method.board: Link 12 conviction board, unchanged ranking: conviction = mean of board-wide percentile ranks of skilled net amount and broker quality.
method.coverage: Debentures / mutual funds never reach this board: Link 12 excludes them by EITHER sector or type signal, and this builder keeps exactly Link 12's symbol set.
method.eps_story: Latest-quarter TTM EPS vs the same quarter a year earlier. Profitable and up = rising; profitable and down = falling; profitable and unchanged = flat; latest EPS <= 0 = loss-making; no year-ago quarter = new; no EPS quarter at all = none (unscored). Percent change only when the year-ago EPS is positive; pp change always published.
method.filing_lag: Forward-study EPS stories use the latest quarter whose approximate quarter-end is at least 60 days before the snapshot, so no future filing leaks into a past reading. Quarter-end mapping is approximate (BS fiscal quarters to AD dates); the 60-day buffer absorbs boundary error.
method.forward: Walk-forward cohorts (top decile by skill over prior snapshots only); 10-session excess vs the equal-weight average stock. Era Aug–Oct 2026, overlapping windows, single regime — descriptive, not a forecast.
method.gaps: 2026-10-07 has broker totals only; the Link 12 board windows spanning it rest on the sessions the archive holds. EPS vintage is 2026-09-30; later filings arrive with the quarterly cycle, not daily.
method.skilled: Skilled = Link 12 top-decile cohort by board skill (brokers whose past accumulation beat the average stock). Skilled net = the signed sum of cohort brokers' net amounts.

source: Link 12 Broker Smart Money board (same session) joined to nepse-chart/data/quarterly.json, published quarterly filings, TTM EPS per quarter
